summary: Linear OAuth apps are self-serve: create an OAuth application in your workspace's API settings, add redirect URLs, and request scopes. Tokens from the authorization-code flow last 24 hours and are refreshed with a refresh token; an app-actor mode lets agents act as the application itself. Linear's docs describe no review or approval step.
key_facts: Create the app in a dedicated workspace — every admin of that workspace gets access to the app
Scopes: read (default, always included), write, narrower ones such as issues:create or comments:create, and admin (request only if essential)
actor=user (default) acts as the authorizing user; actor=app acts as the application — suited to agents and service accounts
Access tokens last 24 hours; refresh requests have a 30-minute replay grace period for network errors
Client-credentials tokens (actor=app) last 30 days, have no refresh token, and must be enabled on the app first
PKCE flows send a code_verifier instead of a client_secret

steps.title: Pick a dedicated workspace
steps.description: Linear recommends a dedicated workspace for managing the app because every admin there can see and edit it.

steps.title: Create the OAuth application
steps.description: Open the API settings page to create a new OAuth2 application. Give it a name and add your redirect callback URLs (for Composio: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).

steps.title: Choose scopes and actor
steps.description: Request the narrowest scopes you need (read is included by default). Use actor=app if an agent should appear as the author of what it creates.
warnings: Avoid the admin scope unless essential

steps.title: Send users to the authorize URL
steps.description: Redirect to https://linear.app/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code and scope (state recommended).

steps.title: Exchange the code and refresh tokens
steps.description: POST to https://api.linear.app/oauth/token with the code, redirect_uri, client_id and client_secret (or code_verifier for PKCE). Store the refresh token and exchange it before the 24-hour expiry.

requirements.account_type: Linear workspace (admin access to create the app)

blockers.title: Short-lived access tokens
blockers.description: Authorization-code access tokens expire after 24 hours, so you must implement refresh.
blockers.workaround: Exchange the refresh token at the token endpoint; reuse the replay grace period for network errors.

blockers.title: Client-credentials flow is opt-in
blockers.description: Server-to-server (actor=app) tokens must be enabled on the app before they work.

next_step: Create a dedicated Linear workspace, open Settings → API → OAuth applications → New, and add your redirect URL. Use Composio managed auth to prototype meanwhile.

if_blocked.situation: Authorization fails with a redirect error
if_blocked.action: Make the redirect_uri identical to one of the callback URLs on the app.

if_blocked.situation: Tokens stop working after a day
if_blocked.action: Refresh them — authorization-code tokens last 24 hours.
